mechanism.trigger: Official Bybit announcement states perpetual-contract delisting time T.
operational_sequence: Active and conditional orders are automatically canceled.
Closing price is based on average index price over the 30 minutes immediately preceding T.

causal_boundaries.announcement_information_time: Must be no later than any strategy decision timestamp; exact publication/observability timestamp must be separately frozen before price testing.
causal_boundaries.delisting_time: T from frozen official announcement semantic result.
causal_boundaries.closing_window: [T-30m, T) conceptually; exact endpoint convention must be verified before economic testing.

prospective_hypothesis.statement: If market participants and forced close mechanics create a repeatable price/index dislocation or liquidity pattern around the announced delisting process, a causal strategy may exhibit gross edge before costs.

edge_to_fill_requirements: Any signal must use only information observable before its decision timestamp.
Execution prices must be derived from contemporaneous executable market data, not future bars or closing values.
Forced-close settlement/index mechanics must not be used as an executable price unless the strategy can actually transact at that reference.
Latency, spread, taker/maker fees, slippage, depth and order-cancel risk must be modeled explicitly.

minimum_viable_horizon.principle: Test multiple pre-specified horizons around T rather than tune to one ex-post interval.
minimum_viable_horizon.forbidden: No horizon selection after inspecting event returns without contamination accounting.

contamination_controls: Frozen 94-event set cannot change after outcome access.
Semantic classes and routing are frozen.
Signal family and horizon grid must be frozen before reading outcome returns.
Any adaptive choice after outcome access must be recorded as contaminated/exploratory.
Holdout or prospective confirmation required before promotion.
falsification_rules: Reject if gross effect is not directionally stable across pre-specified horizons.
Reject if estimated edge disappears under realistic fees/spread/slippage.
Reject if result depends on non-causal use of the 30-minute closing window.
Reject if a small subset of events dominates aggregate performance without a pre-specified reason.
Reject or defer if executable liquidity cannot support the modeled fills.
Do not rescue-tune a failed frozen hypothesis on the same evidence.
